glad: We are glad you are ready to serve and make a generational impact in your community, Africa and the diaspora.
intro: This short guide shows you, step by step, exactly what to tap in WDOS.

scenes.text: This is your WODDI Envoy dashboard. Everything you need is on this one page.
This is your own referral link. Tap Copy link, then paste it in WhatsApp, a text or an email.
Or tap Send on WhatsApp to share it straight away with your groups.
Everyone who joins through your link appears here, with how far she is in her three days.
Tap Message under her name to encourage her. She is told in the app, on her phone and by email.
Tap Tasks at the bottom to see what headquarters has given you. Do it, and submit it.
The bell at the top shows what is new. Tap it to see your notifications.
Change your language here, at the top of every page. Tap Listen to hear the page read aloud.
You are ready. You can open this guide again from the menu, under How to use WDOS. No woman is left out.
